name: Personalised Employment Pass (PEP)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires currently holding an Employment Pass with a fixed monthly salary of at least S$22,500.

value.note: last drawn fixed monthly salary overseas

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a last-drawn fixed monthly salary overseas of at least S$22,500.

evidence_required.document: Salary evidence meeting the S$22,500/month threshold (current EP payslips, or last-drawn overseas salary evidence)

outcome.duration_length: 3 years, not renewable — must switch to another pass before expiry
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: must not remain outside Singapore for more than 6 continuous months

sources.title: Personalised Employment Pass - Ministry of Manpower

notes: GENUINE STRUCTURAL FEATURE, the whole point of this route: NOT tied to a single employer, unlike sg_employment_pass — a PEP holder can take up to 6 months between jobs while remaining in Singapore to search for new employment, a real and meaningful flexibility advantage over the standard EP's 'lose the job, lose the pass immediately' structure. Genuinely terminal duration (3 years, explicitly not renewable) is a real design constraint — must transition to another pass (typically standard EP with the new employer, or ONE Pass if qualifying) before the 3 years run out, distinct from most other 'terminal' routes in this dataset which are terminal because they're entry-level/temporary rather than because a genuinely strong route has a hard cap. COMPASS-exempt (same S$22,500 threshold that exempts standard EP applicants) — no separate points assessment required, since the salary bar itself is the qualifying test.
